events.title: Woodstock Festival's 57th Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, marking a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the original Woodstock. Peace, love, and three days of iconic music that defined a generation. What's your favourite memory or track from the festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake up the airwaves. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your go-to Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid is 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or Liam solo track?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: We celebrate James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred... it's James Bond Day! We're celebrating the world's most famous secret agent. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace still resonates. What's your favourite Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite John Cleese moment?
